result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot or Pipedrive**\. They offer the best balance of ease of use, functionality and room to grow without introducing unnecessary complexity.

However, the best choice depends on how your team manages customers and sales.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Excellent contact and customer management.
- Sales pipeline, email tracking and follow-up reminders.
- Marketing tools and automation.
- Free plan available for up to 2 users.

Best for teams wanting an easy all-in-one solution.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Excellent visual sales pipeline.
- Easy deal and lead tracking.
- Follow-up reminders and sales reporting.
- Very straightforward to learn.

Best for teams actively managing prospects and closing deals.

[Pipedrive website](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

- Excellent value for money.
- Highly customisable.
- Good automation and reporting.
- Free plan for up to 3 users.

Best for businesses wanting lots of functionality without a big budget.

[Zoho website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Sales pipeline and contact management.
- Built-in communication tools.
- Automation and AI features.
- Free plan for small teams.

Best for teams wanting sales and communication tools together.

[Freshsales website](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![monday.com Products | Boost Productivity Today — Elevate Operations](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9pbfxtp9MRSzmGqOOXUT3zYq1fPIuocDylKAQoIzVyuW1Vjc44XoGiROM2GBYduUngwZNPfMFXzqdnmJ1poftmoV-bK85Cp0YYpYmV5sjFjpnjYHjyVWJd9MpDQXQDk0zHwEfS7B57VsWkUtP1cpZQ-ZPXVz1YthngyreHroaIgVKVfnbNj-IFVycI5aW_GQ?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday CRM**

- Visual dashboards and workflows.
- Customer and project management.
- Flexible team collaboration.
- Good customisation.

Best for teams managing customers alongside projects and operations.

[monday CRM website](https://monday.com/crm)

## Quick comparison

Indicative Australian pricing, per user/month on annual billing.

| CRM | Starting price | Best feature |
|--------|--------|--------|
| HubSpot | Free | All-round functionality |
| Pipedrive | A\$19 | Sales pipeline |
| Zoho CRM | A\$22 | Customisation |
| Freshsales | A\$15 | Sales communication |
| monday CRM | A\$19 | Workflow management |


Prices and plan limits can change. [australiansmallbusiness.com.au](https://australiansmallbusiness.com.au/software/best-crm-for-small-business-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[smallbusinesssoftwareguide.com](https://smallbusinesssoftwareguide.com/guides/best-crm-software-for-small-teams/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a small business today\:

- **HubSpot** if you want simplicity and marketing capabilities.
- **Pipedrive** if your priority is managing leads, opportunities and sales.
- **Zoho** if you want flexibility and value.

I'd like to recommend the right CRM rather than just the most popular one.
